migrations.rollbackStrategy: Before consumer enablement, apply the reviewed recovery SQL; after data dependency, preserve mappings and ship a forward-fix migration.
migrations.verification: Apply and recover on disposable PostgreSQL, inspect enum/table/index parity, run uniqueness tests, then execute an explicit environment-scoped backfill dry run.

migrations.rollbackStrategy: Before credential metadata consumers are enabled, apply the reviewed recovery SQL; after dependency, preserve metadata and ship a forward-fix migration.
migrations.verification: Apply and recover on disposable PostgreSQL, inspect enum/table/index/foreign-key parity, verify no raw secret column exists, then reapply.

migrations.rollbackStrategy: Before operation-ledger consumers are enabled, apply the reviewed recovery SQL; after durable records exist, preserve history and ship a forward-fix migration.
migrations.verification: Apply and recover on disposable PostgreSQL; inspect enums, constraints, immutable/append-only triggers, SKIP LOCKED leasing, transaction rollback and concurrent claim behavior.

migrations.rollbackStrategy: Before Phase 26 reliability fields are used by production workers, apply the reviewed recovery SQL; after governed priority/expiry data exists, preserve records and ship a forward-fix migration.
migrations.verification: Apply and recover on disposable PostgreSQL; inspect enum ordering, immutable priority/expiry triggers, operation expiry transitions, priority SKIP LOCKED claims and concurrent worker behavior.

migrations.rollbackStrategy: Before Phase 27 workflow consumers are enabled, apply the reviewed recovery SQL; after durable workflow/reconciliation/replay records exist, preserve them and ship a forward-fix migration.
migrations.verification: Apply and recover on disposable PostgreSQL; inspect enums, constraints, immutable triggers, optimistic version conflicts, lock fencing takeover, reconciliation due indexes and replay uniqueness.

migrations.rollbackStrategy: Before Phase 27 workflow consumers are enabled, apply the reviewed recovery SQL; PostgreSQL enum values remain by design, and after durable records exist use a reviewed forward-fix.
migrations.verification: Generate Prisma Client, apply on disposable PostgreSQL, inspect purpose/replay constraints and immutable triggers, run execution/compensation crash and fencing drills, apply reviewed recovery before data dependency, then reapply.

migrations.rollbackStrategy: Before Phase 30 catalog delete-plan consumers are enabled, apply the reviewed recovery SQL; after durable plan or retry evidence exists, preserve it and ship a forward-fix migration.
migrations.verification: Generate Prisma Client; apply on disposable PostgreSQL; inspect enum, constraints, indexes, relation and immutable trigger; execute recovery before data dependency, then reapply and run catalog safety tests.

migrations.rollbackStrategy: Before Phase 31 unified receipt consumers rely on canonical rows, apply the reviewed destructive recovery SQL; after receipt evidence exists, preserve it and ship a reviewed forward-fix migration.
migrations.verification: Generate Prisma Client; apply on disposable PostgreSQL; verify scoped dedupe, digest mismatch counters, safe metadata checks, replay self-reference and legacy compatibility links; recover before data dependency, then reapply and run Layer 3 persistence tests.

migrations.rollbackStrategy: Before Layer 3.3 lifecycle consumers hold active leases, apply the reviewed recovery SQL; after durable transition evidence exists, preserve it and ship a reviewed forward-fix migration.
migrations.verification: Generate Prisma Client; apply on disposable PostgreSQL; verify guarded transitions, concurrent claim fencing, lease expiry/reclaim, recovery preconditions and controlled replay; recover before data dependency, then reapply and run Layer 3.3 lifecycle tests.

migrations.rollbackStrategy: Before Layer 3.4 provider-identity consumers depend on typed relationships or receipt identity links, apply the reviewed recovery SQL; after durable identity evidence exists, preserve it and ship a reviewed forward-fix migration.
migrations.verification: Generate Prisma Client; apply on disposable PostgreSQL; verify scoped identity uniqueness, typed relationship constraints, receipt identity foreign keys, soft-disable/revocation behavior and safe metadata; recover before data dependency, then reapply and run Layer 3.4 identity tests.

migrations.rollbackStrategy: Before Layer 3.5 Lead receipt, processing-attempt, fingerprint, and handoff consumers depend on the new trace data, apply the reviewed recovery SQL; after durable Lead evidence exists, preserve it and ship a reviewed forward-fix migration.
migrations.verification: Generate Prisma Client; apply on disposable PostgreSQL; verify receipt-to-Lead foreign keys, provider-ID uniqueness, attempt/handoff idempotency, scoped identity references, deterministic backfill and PII-safe fingerprints; recover before data dependency, then reapply and run Layer 3.5 Lead storage tests.

migrations.rollbackStrategy: Before Layer 3.6 scoped Instagram message, outbound, private-reply and attachment-policy consumers depend on the new trace data, apply the reviewed recovery SQL; after durable social CRM evidence exists, preserve it and ship a reviewed forward-fix migration.
migrations.verification: Generate Prisma Client; apply on disposable PostgreSQL; verify scoped conversation/message uniqueness, receipt trace, monotonic ordering, outbound idempotency, unknown-write reconciliation, private-reply one-shot and attachment policy relations; recover before data dependency, then reapply and run Layer 3.6 tests.

migrations.rollbackStrategy: Before Layer 3.7 retention, replay eligibility, approval and audit consumers depend on the new metadata, apply the reviewed recovery SQL; after replay evidence exists, preserve it and ship a reviewed forward-fix migration.
migrations.verification: Generate Prisma Client; apply on disposable PostgreSQL; verify deterministic retention backfill, dedupe-tombstone preservation, source eligibility, unknown-outcome blocking, MetaAdminApproval linkage, replay child trace and sensitive-data absence; recover before dependency, then reapply and run Layer 3.7 tests.
